dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: Two distinct, high-contrast white bands; the upper band is thick and short, while the lower band is thinner and elongated across the greater coverts.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Sharp, high-contrast pale margins visible along the outer edges of the folded primary and secondary feathers against a dark gray base.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly visible white outer rectrices creating high-contrast longitudinal borders on the lateral edges of the tail.
